verdict.rationale: vLLM's continuous batching, chunked prefill, and prefix caching (vllm-docs-3) are explicitly designed to process many requests/items concurrently for peak throughput, and community reports confirm real-world use of vLLM's batching for bulk request processing (vllm-comm-3, vllm-comm-4). The CLI also includes benchmark tooling for offline inference throughput across many prompts (vllm-docs-29). Missing for 10: explicit documentation/example of the offline batch API (e.g., LLM.generate() over a list of prompts) and independent benchmarks quantifying bulk throughput gains.
